overview: Execute a safe, systematic 15–20 minute inspection using RoofER’s standard. Master safety protocols, documentation order, and photography standards.
learningObjectives: Follow RoofER’s inspection methodology (ground → roof → documentation)
Apply critical safety rules and equipment usage
Capture insurance‑ready photo documentation in portrait orientation
Decide when to delay or cancel due to unsafe conditions

sections.title: Safety First Protocol
sections.content: If you do not feel safe, DO NOT DO THE INSPECTION. Ensure ladder placement and angle, check weather (no rain/ice/high wind), assess pitch/surface, verify equipment (Cougar Paws, bungees, pitch hopper, flashlight).

sections.title: Systematic Inspection Methodology
sections.content: Step 1: Introduce and explain 10–15 minute process; safe ladder setup. Step 2: Perimeter—Mailbox/house number, overview, then Front/Right/Rear/Left elevations (screens, gutters, downspouts, siding). Step 3: Roof—overview, roof metals, circle hail hits & slash wind damage, overview of most damage chalked, granules in gutters/downspouts.

sections.title: Photography Standards
sections.content: Photo reports are ALWAYS portrait orientation. Take close‑ups of each damage area and overview shots for context. Document granule loss in gutters/downspouts. Sequence: ID → elevations → collateral → roof overview → individual damage → granules.

sections.title: Time & Efficiency
sections.content: Entire inspection should take 15–20 minutes. Quality over speed: prioritize enough damage photos to convince homeowner. Pre‑position gear, follow the same order each time, take photos as you go.

scenarios.question: Proceed?
scenarios.feedback: Delay until surfaces are dry or use safety alternatives.

scenarios.question: Proceed?
scenarios.feedback: Use Cougar Paws and Pitch Hopper with caution.
